_doc: Round-2 MEDIUM: D3 parses EVERY one of the 458 assets, so a parse defect in an asset carrying no binding at all still decides whether the scan can run. Subject is deliberately such an asset (a property definition, zero CommandBinding_command lines). M13 pins that a genuinely unparseable file is reported BY NAME rather than as a bare js-yaml line number across 458 candidates. ⛔ The OTHER half of that fix — tolerance of a duplicate mapping key, which production's parser has and a bare `yaml.load` did not — deliberately has NO mutant here, and that is a contract limit, not an omission: its correct outcome is that NOTHING reddens, which this driver reports as `красные = НИ ОДНОЙ` and rc=2. A spec that reports rc=2 on every future run cries wolf permanently, which is worse than not locking the half. It was measured once instead, 2026-09-21: injecting a duplicate `exo__Property_description` into this same asset left all four axes GREEN with the mutation applied (so tolerance, not a no-op), where a bare `yaml.load` threw and took D3 down. The same note sits at the code. Predictions were written before the run; `expect` is the MEASURED red set.
